background: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. is the main operating bank of JPMorgan Chase, the largest bank in the United States, serving consumers, businesses, corporates and institutions across the country and worldwide.
synthesis: Ratings are AA from Fitch, AA- from S&P after the upgrade on 15 Nov 2024 and Aa2 from Moody's, all stable, the strongest of any large US operating bank. Capital is strong, with CET1 of 15.0% and leverage of 7.5% both in the top quarter of US banks against the peer medians; CET1 has fallen 0.5 points since 30 Jun 2025. No liquidity ratios are held here for the bank. The flagged news on 10 Sep 2026 and 11 Sep 2026 concerns a lending decision and a lawsuit, neither of which touches the balance sheet. The benchmark US bank on both ratings and capital.
